test_rcfr: test the RcfrSolver class to solve a game using deep learning models with configurable bootstrap and truncate_negative options
test_rcfr_with_buffer: test the ReservoirRcfrSolver class with a reservoir buffer for storing sequence features and regrets during training
test_cfr: test the tabular CFR algorithm using RootStateWrapper to compute counterfactual regrets and converge to an approximate Nash equilibrium
test_rcfr_functions: test the RCFR integration loop combining neural network policy approximation with counterfactual regret minimization
test_root_state_wrapper_sequence_feature: test the RootStateWrapper to generate sequence features by concatenating information state features with one-hot action features
